components.title: Site logging and metrics
components.description: The site log store, log shipping and metrics (OpenSearch, Fluent Bit, Prometheus).

control-implementations.description: What the rendered log shipper, log store, metrics and alerting releases show.

implemented-requirements.description: Audit records go to the site's own log store.

statements.description: Fluent Bit ships the Kubernetes API audit log and every container log through exactly one output, to the site OpenSearch with TLS verification on, and nowhere else. OpenSearch runs with its security plugin and HTTPS on, has an audit-writer role, and a retention policy that deletes old indices; the site Prometheus has no remote write or remote read.
statements.remarks: Your organization decides the retention period and who may read the audit indices.

implemented-requirements.description: A failure to ship audit records raises an alert.

statements.description: The site Prometheus raises an alert when Fluent Bit's output fails or runs out of retries, and when audit records read from the API audit log stop reaching the site OpenSearch, each guarded by the log shipper's scrape target being up; every alert source has a guard. One Alertmanager, from the image lock by digest, mails the alerts over TLS to the site mail server and the site file's recipients only, and a site file without recipients stops the render.
statements.remarks: Your organization names the people who receive the site's alerts and responds to them.

A CI test of the import proves the refusal.
statements.remarks: Your organization builds and signs each bundle it approves with its own key, and imports only that bundle at its site.
